qc_logs.highlights:
1. The final quality control (QC) inspection of 34 ACCL panels has been completed, with no rework required.
2. The final QC of two 13-in-1 Out ACDB panels (Rayzon) revealed two instances of rework needed during testing, both related to the ACB. These issues are attributed to the vendor, not our team. We have reported this to our procurement team for further action with the vendor.
3. Regarding the ZED Silver Certification, last week we finalized the revised design of the SQDCP board.
4. In our lean management initiative, we have established a cross-functional 5S audit team.
5. SoP and JD updated in new software Pipl Hr.
qc_logs.challenges:
1. It is essential to maintain consistent follow-up with the procurement team concerning new requisition and to address any complaints that may arise.
2. Fabrication issues are recurring without any noticeable improvement.
qc_logs.next_plan:
1. New testing trolley design need to be final before 10th October, 2026.
2. Went for TI panel inspection at coronet on 30-09-2026.
qc_logs.support:
Purchase: Timely answer of any mail or messages.
Design & Estimation: Provide some training to fabricator for what production suffers.
HR & Admin: As training form filled about complex wiring need to be arranged as early as possible. Hire admin and QC person as soon as possible.
